summarization:
The smartphone UI screen displays a world map in the background. Overlaid on the map is a pop-up message that reads:

"Thank you.
Download the full version of World Map for more Detailed World Maps and No Ads."

Below the message, there are two options: "LATER" and "CHECK IT OUT."

At the top of the screen, there is a banner advertisement for Spotify Music, offering a free installation. The top bar also includes a prompt to get the full version for more detailed maps. The UI elements suggest that the app is promoting an upgrade to a premium version for enhanced features and an ad-free experience.
